outline: This course introduces students to both qualitative and quantitative approaches to research design and data analysis in language studies, with emphasis on the construction of appropriate methodology for research in first and second language acquisition. A variety of research methods are covered in detail, including both offline and online methodologies. Basic statistical methods for experimental design are also covered.
